fusions.name: Flung Padlocks
fusions.desc: Looses 3 padlocks at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage. Each hit has a 20% chance of [Pinned], holding the target where it stands for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Spring the Latch
fusions.desc: Throws a key that deals 9 damage to a target carrying one of your afflictions, and uses that affliction up.

fusions.name: Turn the Key
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, each condition laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to whoever inflicted it instead.

fusions.name: Quick Fingers
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
